description: This file defines interfaces and data structures related to mathematical solving and graph analysis within the Graphing namespace, including the IMathSolver interface which provides methods for parsing expressions, creating graph objects, and analyzing graph data.

classes.name: IGraphFunctionAnalysisData
classes.description: Holds analysis data for a graph function, including domain, range, extrema, asymptotes, and other features.

classes.name: IParsingOptions
classes.description: Interface for parsing options, allowing configuration of format and localization types.

classes.name: IEvalOptions
classes.description: Interface for evaluation options, specifically for setting and getting trigonometric unit modes.

classes.name: IFormatOptions
classes.description: Interface for format options, including setting format type, MathML prefix, and localization.

classes.name: IMathSolver
classes.description: Main interface for mathematical expression parsing, graph creation, and analysis.

methods.name: CreateMathSolver
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of IMathSolver.

methods.name: ParsingOptions
methods.description: Returns a reference to the parsing options interface.

methods.name: EvalOptions
methods.description: Returns a reference to the evaluation options interface.

methods.name: FormatOptions
methods.description: Returns a reference to the format options interface.

methods.name: ParseInput
methods.description: Parses a string input into an expression, returning a unique pointer to IExpression and error codes.

methods.name: HRErrorToErrorInfo
methods.description: Converts an HRESULT error code into error information.

methods.name: CreateGrapher
methods.description: Creates a graph object from an expression or as a default graph.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an expression into a string representation.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Performs analysis on a graph using a graph analyzer.
